Selectors and combinators
Selectors match elements. Combinators describe relationships between those elements.

direct child, + එJකන් ළඟම ඊළඟ sibling, ~ එJකන් පෙසුව ඇති matching siblings Jතතෝරනවා.

Jකාළ පොට direct child p එක > selector එකට match Jවනවා. Nested p එක space selector එකටතේ match
Expected result: Nested paragraphs become blue; only direct children of .card become bold.
Interview question: What is the difference between a descendant and child selector?

Answer: A descendant may be nested at any depth, while a child must have the specified direct
parent.
Remember: Space = any depth; > = one level.
Practice: Style direct and nested paragraphs differently.
